title: Remove PDF Exports from pre-login page feature list

requirements.text: Remove the 'PDF Exports' list item from the pre-login page UI element identified by XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/div[4]/ul[1]/li[3]. This item should no longer appear in that list.

quotes: Remove PDF exports from this text.

acceptanceCriteria: The 'PDF Exports' list item is no longer rendered in the specified section of the pre-login/login page.
All other list items in that section remain unchanged.
No visual regressions are introduced on the login page.

constraints: Only remove the 'PDF Exports' list item from the targeted UI element; do not modify any other content or features.
nonGoals: Removing PDF export functionality from the dashboard or ExportTab.
Modifying backend logic related to export quotas.
Changing the usePdfExport hook or any export-related hooks.
